title: Thermal Cycling Test Controller — Overview and definition
t: Thermal Cycling Test Controller — Overview and definition
description: Runs precise temperature-cycle profiles for reliability stress screening.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Runs precise temperature-cycle profiles for reliability stress screening. A thermal cycling test controller drives chambers through JEDEC/MIL temperature cycles with controlled ramp rates, dwells, and in-situ monitoring. Real implementations are chamber vendor software plus LabVIEW/Python supervisors. It counts cycles, monitors DUT health live, and stops on failure signatures.
